hook: orphan 勤奮團猛打卡：assiduous／sedulous／industrious／diligent——打卡機過熱，保全說「請輪流」。
script: assiduous／sedulous／industrious 勤奮。diligent 勤勉。painstaking 一絲不苟。tireless 不知疲倦。口令：打卡寫「持續」，別只表演忙碌。

members.senseAnchor: marked by care and persistent effort
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 持續檔: sedulous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「持續檔」出場：sedulous 一上場梗就黏住——勤奮的。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by hard work and perseverance; working hard to promote an enterprise
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 工蜂: industrious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「工蜂」出場：industrious 一上場梗就黏住——勤勞的。

related.synonyms: hardworking, tireless, untiring, energetic, gumptious, up-and-coming
